Ivtex collaborates with organizations across diverse industries to design robust, scalable, and future-ready solutions. Job Description – AI/ML Engineer

Position:
AI/ML Engineer
Department:
Technology / AI & Data Science
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Location:
Bhubaneswar, Odisha
Reporting To:
Technical Lead / Project Manager
Experience:
2–5 Years
Qualification:
B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related field

Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated AI/ML Engineer
to design, develop, deploy, and maintain Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for real-world business applications.
The candidate will be responsible for the complete ML lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, API integration, performance monitoring, and optimization. The role may also involve Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision, NLP, and intelligent automation depending on project requirements.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, test, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models.
Analyze and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets for model development.
Perform data cleaning, feature engineering, feature selection, and exploratory data analysis.
Develop predictive models, classification models, recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, and other ML-based applications.
Build solutions using Python
and ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost
, or equivalent technologies.
Develop and integrate Generative AI and LLM-based applications
, where required.
Work with LLM APIs and open-source models for applications such as chatbots, document intelligence, summarization, information extraction, and knowledge assistants.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and prompt engineering for GenAI applications.
Work on NLP and/or Computer Vision
solutions based on project requirements.
Develop REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask
for AI/ML model integration.
Deploy ML models into production environments and integrate them with web/mobile/backend applications.
Optimize models for accuracy, latency, scalability, and computational efficiency.
Establish model evaluation metrics and conduct validation, testing, and performance benchmarking.
Monitor deployed models for performance degradation, data drift, model drift, and other production issues.
Maintain proper model versioning, experiment tracking, documentation, and reproducibility.
Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, business analysts, QA teams, and project managers.
Convert business requirements into technically feasible AI/ML solutions.
Research emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applicability to organizational projects.
Follow data privacy, information security, and responsible AI practices.

Required Technical Skills
Programming:

Python, SQL
Machine Learning:

Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, XGBoost/LightGBM, feature engineering, supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and optimization
Deep Learning:

PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras, neural networks, CNNs, Transformers
Generative AI / LLM:

LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, LLM APIs and/or open-source models
NLP:

Text preprocessing, classification, information extraction, semantic search, transformers
Computer Vision – Preferred:

OpenCV, object detection, image classification, OCR and related vision models
API Development:

FastAPI / Flask / REST API integration
Databases:

MySQL/PostgreSQL and exposure to NoSQL databases
MLOps / Deployment:

Docker, Git, CI/CD fundamentals, model versioning, experiment tracking and production model monitoring
Cloud – Preferred:

AWS / Microsoft Azure / Google Cloud Platform

Preferred Tools & Technologies
Exposure to some of the following will be advantageous:
Hugging Face Transformers
LangChain / LlamaIndex or similar frameworks
FAISS / Pinecone / Weaviate / Chroma or other vector databases
MLflow / Weights & Biases
Jupyter Notebook
Git/GitHub/GitLab
Docker
Kubernetes
Apache Airflow
OpenCV
ONNX
Cloud-based AI/ML services

Required Knowledge
The candidate should have a strong understanding of:
Machine Learning algorithms
Statistics and probability
Linear algebra fundamentals
Data preprocessing and feature engineering
Model selection and hyperparameter tuning
Classification, regression and clustering
Deep Learning architectures
Transformers and modern AI architectures
Model evaluation metrics
Data structures and algorithms
ML deployment and inference pipelines
API-based model integration
Data security and privacy principles

Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues
Strong coding and debugging skills
Research-oriented approach to emerging AI technologies
Ability to understand business problems and translate them into AI solutions
Good documentation skills
Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration
Ability to manage multiple development tasks and project deadlines

Preferred Candidate Profile
Preference will be given to candidates who have:
Developed and deployed at least one production-level AI/ML application.
Hands-on experience taking an ML project from data preparation → model development → deployment → monitoring
.
Experience developing GenAI/LLM applications using RAG or similar architectures.
Experience integrating AI models with existing software applications.
Experience working with large datasets and production databases.
A strong GitHub portfolio or demonstrable AI/ML projects.
Experience working on government, enterprise, smart-city, surveillance, analytics, or large-scale technology projects will be an added advantage.

Selection Process
Candidates may be evaluated through:
Resume/Profile Screening
Technical Interview
Practical AI/ML Assignment or Coding Test
Project/Model Demonstration
Final Technical/Management Discussion

During the technical evaluation, candidates should be prepared to explain one AI/ML project end-to-end
, including the business problem, dataset, preprocessing, model selection, evaluation metrics, deployment architecture, challenges faced, and final results.

Expected Deliverables
The selected AI/ML Engineer will be expected to deliver reliable and production-ready AI solutions, maintain appropriate technical documentation, support deployment and integration, monitor model performance, and continuously improve AI/ML systems based on business and project requirements.

About The Role

As a Responsible AI Engineer
, you will make an impact by engineering the trust, safety, and governance layer for agentic AI systems deployed at enterprise scale. You will be a valued member of the AI Market Unit (FDE Pod)
and work collaboratively with AI engineers, architects, risk teams, and client stakeholders
to ensure every AI solution is safe, compliant, and production-ready.

In This Role, You Will

Design and implement runtime guardrails and safety architectures for LLM and agentic AI systems, including input/output controls, prompt injection detection, and policy enforcement mechanisms
Lead red-teaming and adversarial testing initiatives to identify vulnerabilities such as jailbreaks, prompt injections, and trust boundary violations before production deployment
Build and operationalize AI governance and compliance frameworks, translating regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF) into enforceable engineering controls
Develop and deploy fairness, bias, and model evaluation pipelines, including hallucination detection, groundedness validation, and subgroup performance analysis
Establish observability and auditability for AI systems through structured logging, audit trails, governance metrics, and incident response processes

Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week
in a Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad
.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

Experience in software engineering or ML engineering, with hands-on exposure to AI safety, governance, or trust engineering
Proven experience building and deploying LLM or agentic AI systems in enterprise or regulated environments
Strong expertise in at least two of the following: guardrails engineering, red teaming, bias/fairness evaluation, AI regulatory compliance
Working knowledge of AI regulatory frameworks such as EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or sector-specific compliance standards
Strong Python programming skills, with experience building evaluation pipelines, observability systems, or AI governance tooling
Ability to collaborate with security, legal, and risk stakeholders, translating technical AI risks into actionable insights for business leaders
Excellent communication and executive-level presentation skills, with experience presenting to senior client stakeholders

These will help you stand out

Hands-on experience conducting red-team assessments on production AI systems and remediating critical vulnerabilities
Experience creating audit-ready AI governance and compliance documentation for external or regulatory review
Ability to influence AI system design decisions by balancing technical feasibility with regulatory and risk considerations
Experience integrating fairness, safety evaluation, and monitoring pipelines into CI/CD workflows
Exposure to enterprise AI tooling such as NeMo Guardrails, Giskard, Arize, LangChain/LangGraph, or similar ecosystems

We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. jobs.title: Full stack AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the job What you’ll actually do Build real things. You’ll write production code across the full stack — React frontends, Python/Node backends, ClickHouse queries, Kafka event pipelines, LangGraph agent workflows, and YAML-driven process definitions. Not prototypes. Not demos. Stuff that runs in production for real companies moving real cargo across real oceans. Talk to enterprise clients. You’ll sit across from logistics managers, freight forwarders, and operations leads. You’ll listen to their messy, exception-filled processes — 6 approval levels, 4 document types, 3 systems that don’t talk to each other — and turn that chaos into structured workflows they can actually use. This isn’t optional. It’s the job. Think AI-first. Every problem you encounter, your first question should be: “Can an agent handle this?” Not “let me build a CRUD app.” You’ll design agents that extract fields from Bills of Lading, validate invoices against purchase orders, auto-route approvals based on business rules, and flag exceptions before humans even notice them. You’ll work with LLMs, RAG pipelines, document parsers, and agent orchestration frameworks daily. Own problems end-to-end. You won’t hand off a spec and wait. You’ll identify the problem, design the solution, build it, configure it for the client, deploy it, watch it in production, and fix what breaks. The FDE model means you own outcomes, not tasks. The tech you’ll work with Frontend: React, React Flow (node-based graph editors) Backend: Python, Node.js, FastAPI Data: ClickHouse, Kafka (event streaming), Debezium (CDC) AI/ML: LangGraph (agent orchestration), LLMs (prompt engineering, RAG, tool use), DPT-2 (document extraction), PageIndex (long-document reasoning), Weaviate (vector search) Permissions: OpenFGA (Zanzibar-based relationship access control) Observability: Langfuse (LLM tracing), OpenTelemetry Cost control: LiteLLM (gateway + budgets), Orkestra (model routing) Infrastructure: dbt (semantic layer / MetricFlow), Temporal (scheduling), DataHub / OpenMetadata (catalog) You don’t need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can pick up any of it in a week. What we’re looking for The non-negotiables You can code. Full-stack, independently, at production quality. You’ve built things — not just assignments, but projects, tools, systems that other people actually used. You’re comfortable across the stack and you don’t need hand-holding to ship a feature. You can communicate. You can explain a technical architecture to a non-technical client. You can run a discovery call. You can write a clear document. You can present without slides being your crutch. This is not a “nice to have.” Half the job is translating between the worlds of technology and business. You can think. When someone describes a messy process, you don’t just nod — you ask why before how. You spot patterns underneath apparent chaos. You push back on unnecessary complexity. You can hold a system in your head and reason about what happens when things go wrong. You learn fast. You don’t need to know logistics. You need to be the kind of person who, after two client calls and a week of reading, can hold their own in a conversation about Bills of Lading, demurrage charges, and incoterm implications. Domain knowledge is teachable. Curiosity and raw learning speed are not. Strong signals You’ve built something with LLMs — not just used ChatGPT, but actually integrated an LLM into a working system. Prompt engineering, tool use, agents, RAG — any of it. You’ve worked on a side project or open-source contribution that required you to understand a domain outside of CS. You can take a vague, messy brief and turn it into a structured plan without needing everything spelled out. You default to shipping over perfecting. You’d rather build a rough working version in 2 hours than spend 2 days on a flawless spec. You’ve done consulting, client-facing work, or been in a situation where you had to understand someone else’s world to solve their problem. What this role is NOT It’s not a pure backend/frontend engineering job where you write code in isolation. It’s not a PM role where you make decks and write tickets but never ship code. It’s not a consulting gig where you give advice but don’t build. It’s not a support role where you configure existing products without understanding the architecture. * About GoComet GoComet is a supply chain visibility and automation platform used by enterprises across 30+ countries. We track shipments across ocean, air, road, and rail. We manage procurement, contracts, invoices, and compliance. And now, with Nova, we’re building the AI-native operating layer that ties it all together. Logistics moves $12 trillion in goods every year. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, email chains, and phone calls. We’re fixing that — not with another dashboard, but with intelligent, governed, agent-driven automation.

About ABV

ABV works across investing, business building and technology-led execution. We strengthen products, modernise systems and improve operations to drive growth.

Our work spans commercial opportunities and government and enterprise needs, combining research, operational improvement and hands-on implementation. This scope also includes improving and scaling technology businesses following acquisition: strengthening products, integrating systems and building the operational foundations for growth.

About the role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Products & Solutions to build and deliver the technology behind these initiatives.

You’ll translate business requirements into working software, make practical technical decisions and take clearly scoped projects or components through development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement. The role combines product thinking with hands-on engineering and responsibility for delivery.

The scope includes enterprise applications, AI-assisted workspaces, automation and software supporting public-sector and utility operations. Some projects will involve building new products; others will require integrating systems and delivering against client requirements.

We believe the right engineers, equipped with strong AI fluency and sound judgment, can become 10x builders. We’re looking for people who turn that potential into working software: using AI to learn unfamiliar systems, test ideas, automate repetitive work and ship faster without compromising quality. You don’t need years of experience to demonstrate this, but you do need to show what you have built. AI will be central to how you work, even when the product itself is not an AI application.

Responsibilities

• Turn business and user requirements into implementation plans, technical choices and clear delivery milestones.
• Build applications, interfaces, backend services, databases, APIs and integrations.
• Write maintainable code, use version control and document important design decisions.
• Choose and combine AI coding tools, models and agents to research, implement, test and debug software. Review their output and take responsibility for the result.
• Write automated tests, investigate failures and check edge cases before release.
• Deploy and monitor software, troubleshoot production issues and improve reliability, performance and running costs.
• Work with clients, users, vendors and domain specialists to clarify requirements, resolve blockers and support acceptance testing.
• Build security, appropriate access controls, data validation and auditability into the systems you deliver.
• Contribute to post-acquisition improvement projects by modernising software, integrating systems and automating workflows to support business growth.
• Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly.

Minimum qualifications

• Ability to write and debug code in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go or C++.
• Understanding of core programming concepts, common data structures and basic algorithmic efficiency.
• Practical experience building a software project using APIs, persistent data storage or a user interface.
• Familiarity with Git and the fundamentals of testing and debugging.
• Ability to break an unfamiliar problem into manageable steps and explain your implementation choices.
• Evidence of work you can demonstrate and discuss, whether from employment, internships, coursework, independent projects or open-source contributions.

Recent graduates and early-career engineers are welcome. A computer science or related degree is useful, but equivalent practical experience is welcome. You do not need prior experience in every area of the role.

Preferred experience

• Building web or desktop applications with responsive, accessible interfaces.
• Working with relational databases, data modelling and third-party integrations.
• Deploying applications to cloud environments and using automated build, test or deployment workflows.
• Working with LLM APIs, tool calling, agent workflows and evaluations.
• Handling background tasks, streaming updates, session state and error recovery.
• Managing permissions, credentials and sensitive data securely.
• Building billing, payment reconciliation or operational software.

Familiarity with electricity utilities, public-sector systems or other regulated environments is a plus, not a requirement.

How you work

You care about whether software solves the user’s problem, not just whether the code runs.

We value high agency: taking initiative, proposing next steps, raising blockers early and seeing work through. You should be comfortable using AI extensively while retaining the judgment to question its output, verify results and recognise when specialist input is needed.

Ownership and growth

You’ll take responsibility for clearly defined deliverables, with room to own larger projects as you demonstrate sound judgment and reliable execution. The scope of responsibility will reflect your experience and the requirements of each project.

To apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Where available, include links to projects, GitHub repositories or working demos within your CV, with a brief description of your contribution.

Users can create and host sessions, actively participate, share perspectives, and engage in meaningful discussions as they happen. The platform supports creators, experts, and enthusiasts who want to grow communities, share knowledge, and connect with others in an engaging, participatory format. LYFeX’s mission is to transform audiences into active contributors, making participation the core experience rather than content consumption.
Role Description
The AI Engineering Trainer at LYFeX is a part-time, remote role focused on designing and delivering engaging live sessions that teach AI and engineering concepts to diverse participant groups. This role involves planning curricula and session outlines, preparing examples and exercises, and presenting complex technical topics in an accessible and interactive manner. The trainer will host live audio/video rooms, facilitate Q&A, guide hands-on activities or demos, and encourage participation from learners with varying levels of experience.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in AI and software engineering, including practical experience with machine learning concepts, model development, and deployment workflows.
Proficiency with relevant tools and technologies such as Python, common ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), and modern development practices (e.g., version control, testing, documentation).
Demonstrated ability to teach or train others, with experience in curriculum design, technical instruction, mentoring, or conducting workshops in a remote or hybrid format.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain complex topics clearly, manage live discussions, and encourage inclusive participation.
Comfort with live audio/video platforms and virtual collaboration tools, with the ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues during sessions.
Strong organizational skills and reliability, including consistent session preparation, timely follow-up with participants, and responsiveness to feedback.
Commitment to a gender-neutral, non-discriminatory, and learner-centered approach, with sensitivity to participants from varied backgrounds and skill levels.
Relevant academic background in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience; prior experience as a trainer, instructor, or content creator is a plus

jobs.description:
About ZeroTab

ZeroTab is building a simpler way for people to understand their money.
Today, a person’s financial life is spread across multiple bank apps, credit cards, investment platforms, loan accounts, and UPI apps. ZeroTab brings all of this together into one clear, single-screen view
.
Built for India’s UPI-first, multi-app financial ecosystem, ZeroTab focuses on clarity and financial education rather than selling financial products or earning commissions
.
Features like Cash Runway, Subscription Radar, and What-If Calculator
help users understand their spending, identify recurring payments, and explore different financial scenarios. Our AI-powered experience helps users ask questions and get personalized insights based on their own financial data.
Our goal is simple: make personal finance easier to understand.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer
to help build the backend systems that power ZeroTab’s financial dashboard, analytics, and AI-driven experiences.
You’ll work on more than just individual APIs. You’ll help build the systems that connect financial data, power calculations and insights, support AI features, and turn complex financial information into something useful for users.
You’ll work closely with product, design, and frontend engineers
to take features from an idea through development and into production.

What You’ll Work On

Build and maintain reliable backend services and REST APIs
.
Design systems for handling financial and user data securely and reliably
.
Integrate with banking, financial-data, and other external services.
Build the backend logic behind features such as Cash Runway, Subscription Radar, and What-If Calculator
.
Develop services that support our AI-powered financial insights and chat experience
.
Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data flows.
Improve application performance, scalability, reliability, and data consistency
.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code.
Debug production issues and contribute to improving system reliability.
Collaborate with frontend and product teams to deliver features end-to-end.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation and engineering practices.

What We’re Looking For

Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and system design
.
Hands-on experience building backend applications and REST APIs
.
Experience developing and maintaining production-grade software
.
Good understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases
.
Familiarity with API design, authentication, data validation, error handling, and security.
Good software engineering practices around testing, debugging, version control, and code reviews
.
Ability to understand how individual features fit into a larger system.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a small, cross-functional team.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

﻿

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and modern deployment practices
.
Experience working with fintech, banking, payments, or other sensitive-data systems
.
Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered applications
or data-driven products.
Interest in personal finance and fintech
.

Why ZeroTab?

You’ll be joining at an early stage, where the engineering decisions we make today will directly shape the product and its architecture.
You’ll have the opportunity to work across backend engineering, financial data, analytics, AI, APIs, and product development
rather than being limited to one small part of the stack.
If you enjoy solving real engineering problems, building things from the ground up, and want to work on a product that helps people better understand their money, we’d love to hear from you.

Company Description

Viral Pitch is an AI-powered influencer marketing SaaS platform
helping brands and agencies discover influencers, automate campaign workflows, manage content, contracts and payments, and measure campaign performance at scale.

We are looking for an AI Engineer
to build the intelligence layer behind our platform. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking AI from experimentation to production-grade products
.

Role Description

Design, build and deploy AI/ML features
across the Viral Pitch platform.
Build AI agents and workflows for influencer discovery, matching, outreach, negotiation, content analysis, campaign strategy and reporting
.
Work with LLMs, multimodal models, embeddings, RAG, vector databases and AI APIs.
Build reliable AI pipelines for processing text, images, videos, social-media data and campaign data
.
Develop prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling and agentic workflows.
Integrate models from providers such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic and other emerging AI platforms
.
Evaluate models and choose the right combination of quality, latency and cost
for production use.
Build AI systems that can operate at scale while maintaining accuracy, consistency and reliability.
Develop evaluation frameworks and monitoring for AI outputs. Fine-tune or adapt models where required.
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to convert business requirements into practical AI solutions. Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and take successful prototypes into production.
Stay current with developments in Generative AI, AI Agents, multimodal AI and LLM infrastructure
.

What we are looking for

2–6 years of experience
in AI/ML engineering, Generative AI or a closely related field.
Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs and Generative AI APIs
.
Understanding of embeddings, vector search, RAG and prompt engineering.
Experience building production AI applications
, not just notebooks or prototypes.
Strong understanding of APIs, databases and backend systems.
Ability to evaluate AI outputs systematically and improve model performance.
Strong problem-solving ability and willingness to experiment rapidly.
Ability to work independently and take a feature from idea → prototype → production
.
